u0: Normal progress: keep the box in hand and move toward the exit. Reaching the exit while still holding the box succeeds in u2; if the box falls, switch to immediate recovery in u1.
u1: Recovery after a fall: the box is out of your hands and normally lies in the cell you now face. Your very next move must be to pick it up; doing so earns a small recovery reward and returns to u0. Any other move leaves it unheld and fails into u3.
u2: Success terminal state: you reached the exit while holding the box. The main task is complete and no further actions are needed.
u3: Failure terminal state: you did not pick the box up on the move immediately after it fell. The recovery window is lost, no further reward can be earned, and the run is effectively over.
